interpretation.ablation: Weight ablations reuse the same observed evidence; sensitivity is not training effectiveness or repair gain.
interpretation.costs: Delivery wall seconds cover official task setup through patch delivery, including model queue wait, and exclude judge setup/verification. Missing delivery timing is unknown. Worker, verification and request seconds can overlap; their sums are not GPU wall time or billing.
interpretation.missingness: No provable signal with missing evidence does not establish that missingness caused zero signal.
interpretation.partial_groups: All valid trajectories in a finalized group are retained, regardless of reward. Infrastructure attrition can still change the observed population; collection evidence records planned versus valid size and does not establish unbiased sampling.
interpretation.sampling: These are adaptively sampled training candidates, not an unbiased uniform-task evaluation.
interpretation.unknown_rewards: Missing totals/components remain None and are excluded from observed-value statistics, not counted as zero.
interpretation.updates: Selection is not completion. Optimizer-call membership is separate from non-skipped nonzero-LR membership. Zero-LR/skipped calls do not enter the latter; missing historical nonzero-LR counts remain unknown. A nonzero-LR call still does not prove changed parameters; adapter_changed records that separately.

weighting.interpretation: Absolute scalar/token exposure before PPO ratios, clipping, parameter Jacobians and trajectory/fixed-length loss denominators. Optimizer-call counts include zero-LR or skipped calls; nonzero-LR counts require a non-skipped call with a nonzero used LR. Neither proves parameter change, actual gradient magnitude, uniform-task correction, or repair gain; adapter_changed remains separate evidence.
